description: 消防水利整備一覧 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 久留米市. 久留米市の消防水利（消火栓／防火水そう）整備一覧です。. Coverage: 久留米市. The portal files it under the publisher 久留米市. Its tags are 一覧, 安全安心, 消火栓, 消防水利, 災害. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
